description: **Streaming text-repetition abort** stops a turn that degenerates into a mechanical token/chunk loop (`repetition_guard`). On by default; disable with `text_repetition_guard.enabled=false`.
**Cross-turn loop guard** cancels after three consecutive turns with the same reply and the same tool.
**codemode meta-tool** orchestrates search/use inside a QuickJS sandbox so intermediate results stay out of the main context. Configure via `[toolset.codemode]`.
**Session titles re-refresh on idle/end** instead of fixed turn checkpoints. Manual `/rename` still freezes; `/rename --auto` reopens.
**CJK fallback titles** truncate on character boundaries; failed generations no longer burn the refresh.
**Windows path suggestions** no longer return empty for file and PATH tokens.
Peak RSS sampling uses `GetProcessMemoryInfo` on Windows. `test-uploads` is test-only; release privacy gates stay closed.
Community independent build with privacy hardening and Windows adaptations.
